reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows recalled model B0726Y, and the date code 8/21 is within the recalled range, so the model and date code are confirmed.

The purchase date 2023-05-14 is inside the sale window, but the retailer 'Corner Hardware Co' is not on the list of sales locations. Under the FAQ, a purchase from an unlisted store is not denied; the claimant is asked for proof of ownership.
The destruction photo does not show the instructed destruction (cutting off the straps). It shows an intact helmet with no visible cut, so a new destruction photo is needed.
No duplicate claims were found, so the flag rule does not apply.

input.question_for_claimant: Please send (1) proof of ownership for the helmet bought at Corner Hardware Co on 2023-05-14, such as a receipt, bank or card statement, or other proof of purchase, and (2) a new photo of the helmet with both straps cut off, as the recall instructs. Please make sure the photo is of the helmet itself and is not a repeat of the label photo.
